items.name: hoshikuzu-theme
items.title: Hoshikuzu Theme
items.description: Night atlas and archive sheet tokens, type, radius, shadows, motion and utilities.

theme.font-sans: "Inter", "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Yu Gothic UI", "Yu Gothic", "Meiryo", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Code", "Cascadia Mono", "Consolas", "Noto Sans Mono CJK JP", monospace

@utility atlas-starfield.background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, var(--star-dot) 0 1px, transparent 1.4px), radial-gradient(circle at 74% 18%, var(--star-dot-signal) 0 1px, transparent 1.4px), radial-gradient(circle at 42% 76%, var(--star-dot-lamp) 0 1px, transparent 1.4px), linear-gradient(var(--graticule) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--graticule) 1px, transparent 1px)

items.docs: Night is the default. Set <html data-atlas-mode="archive"> for the light archive sheet, or use AtlasModeProvider from @hoshikuzu/atlas-mode.
